description:
Who We Are

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

You know how it feels when you walk into your favorite coffee shop and they know your name and start prepping your usual? Imprint makes it possible for the largest brands to create that experience at scale.

We bring payments, loyalty, and customer intelligence together in one platform, so brands can recognize and reward customers as individuals and keep them coming back. With the power of our technology and data, brands create financial products that their customers’ use everyday, earning more of their spend and increasing loyalty. Customers are rewarded with money and time saved, and surprised and delighted with a more unique, tailored experience.

We first proved our business in co-brand credit cards. For decades, the same few banks dominated the industry, building brands’ programs on mainframes older than the internet. We took a different approach, rebuilding the technology from the ground up. Today, Imprint has more than two million members, with partners like Shell, Kroger, H-E-B, and Booking.com representing half a trillion dollars in total US consumer spend. Now, we’re growing our partnerships, bringing on more members, and expanding beyond credit cards so that brands offer more ways to pay and be rewarded to recognize their customers as individuals no matter their income or preferences.

Better yet, we’re doing it differently with a lean team of the most talented people on earth. Historically, companies scaled by adding people. Imprint is taking on our opportunity with a small team of exceptional people, with the best AI and technology dramatically amplifying what each person can accomplish. That means you’ll learn faster here than you could anywhere else. You’ll be one of the few people building an entirely new technology with the ownership and trust to shape what Imprint becomes. You’ll work alongside people who make you sharper everyday, armed with tools that turn your best ideas into reality faster than you thought possible. This is a rare chance to do the most important work of your career and to help prove that a small team can build what’s never been done before, inside industries that haven’t changed in decades.

Role summary

As Partner Marketing Manager, you will own marketing for Imprint's launch partners, taking each new co-brand program from pre-launch through its first couple months in market. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will set the strategy and you will also do the work: write the briefs, build the assets, ship the launches, and report on results.

You are the marketing point of contact for your partners. You will build each partner's marketing plan, run every launch workstream, design acquisition journeys, and make sure every piece of work clears brand, legal, bank, and network review. You will work closely with Partner Success, Lifecycle, Data Science, Creative, and Compliance to get programs to market fast and grow them once they're live.

Responsibilities

Partner strategy and planning

  • Own the marketing strategy and quarterly plan for each launch partner

  • Build and share a marketing strategy and quarterly plan for each assigned launch partner, including full marketing workstream: assets, landing pages, and launch comms

  • Plan and run joint campaigns with partner marketing teams

  • Write partner-facing marketing comms and keep partners informed on plans and results

  • Run the flighting calendar, quarterly planning, and intake process as the single source of truth for partner marketing work

Launch marketing

  • Own the marketing workstream for every program and campaign launch, including assets, landing pages, launch comms, and PR

  • Build an asset bank for launch and sustain phases, aligned with the partner playbook and toolkit

Acquisition

  • Set top-of-funnel strategy and offers for each partner

  • Build and optimize ITA and prescreen journeys

  • Drive acquisition through in-store and partner-owned channels

Lifecycle

  • Brief Lifecycle Managers on key moments in each partner's retail and marketing calendar

Creative and brand

  • Manage design and copy, working within Imprint brand, partner guidelines, and the design system

  • Manage translations for multilingual programs

Measurement

  • Partner with Data Science to set marketing KPIs, including LTV/CAC and spend per active

  • Design tests, report on results, and use what you learn to shape the next plan

Compliance

  • Route all marketing through the required legal, bank, and network reviews and keep launches on schedule

Budget

  • Provide input on spend priorities

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of partner, product, or growth marketing experience, ideally in financial services or fintech

  • Hands-on experience launching new products, programs, or partnerships end to end

  • Experience running acquisition journeys, including prescreen or ITA direct mail and partner or in-store channels

  • Strong project management: you can run a calendar, an intake process, and multiple launches at once without dropping details

  • Experience managing creative production with designers and copywriters, including brand and partner guidelines

  • Comfort working with data teams to define KPIs, design tests, and report results

  • Experience moving work through legal and regulatory review in a regulated industry

  • Clear writer and communicator who can present plans and results to partners

Nice to have

  • Co-brand credit card or loyalty program experience

  • Experience with prescreen data providers (TransUnion, Acxiom) and direct mail vendors

  • Familiarity with Braze or similar lifecycle tools

  • Experience at a high-growth startup where you built the playbook while shipping

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Medical plan options fully paid by Imprint, including coverage for your dependents

  • 100% company-paid dental and vision plan options

  • Mental health support through Spring Health, plus a confidential Employee Assistance Program

  • Healthcare navigation through Rightway, plus HSA, FSA and commuter benefits

  • Flexible paid time off

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • The latest tools and technology, including AI, so you can do your best work

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.
